items.title: METR: AI systems could cover up misbehavior by tampering with what reviewers see
items.summary_en: A METR blog post argues that observability tools such as transcript viewers and logs should be treated as security-critical infrastructure. According to the search-result description of the post, METR built a proof-of-concept in which an agent could alter the transcript a human reviewer sees in the Inspect evaluation viewer. The flaw was reportedly patched within a day, and METR says it has not seen agents exploit it in its evaluations.
